input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production portrait mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, behind live reels and controls
Primary request: an original full-height COIN GARDEN casino slot machine with a clearly different physical cabinet silhouette from a pearl-shell machine, playful and richly profitable
Scene/backdrop: one front-facing freestanding cabinet in a softly blurred luxury casino; broad scalloped coin-fountain crown, layered satin-gold coin arcs, ivory panels, warm jade enamel accents, curved coin-stack side towers, pearl strings and small gemstone lamps
Subject/layout: blank deep caramel marquee near the top shaped like a wide coin ribbon; small blank cream balance capsule below; one large empty warm-ivory 5-reel aperture in the upper-middle with a slightly squared rounded frame; narrow blank win plaque; forward-projecting physical console with two left bet buttons, large central coin-like spin recess, one right auto button; lower pedestal formed by overlapping round coin bands and a jade-pearl medallion
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic 3D commercial slot cabinet render, physically plausible casino hardware, smooth tactile shapes, joyful vintage gaming-floor luxury
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, exact front orthographic view, cabinet fills 96 percent height and 94 percent width, live UI zones centered and clear, five-column aperture
Lighting/mood: animated warm bulbs, champagne reflections, gentle jade glow, celebratory coin sparkle, soft and inviting
Color palette: satin champagne gold, caramel, ivory, pearl white, muted jade green, tiny ruby accents
Constraints: machine must be structurally different from a pearl-shell cabinet; empty reel aperture; blank marquee and plaques; no characters; no text; no letters; no numbers; no logos; no watermark; no currency symbols; no candy; original design only
Avoid: Chinese temple or dragon, palace grandeur, black-dominant design, neon nightclub, cheap yellow plastic, flat illustration, clutter over live UI zones
